newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-GREECE MISS PENALTY AND DRAW WITH PORTUGAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GREECE MISS PENALTY AND DRAW WITH PORTUGAL.

text.p: Portugal goalkeeper Vitor Baia saved a second half penalty to ensure a goalless draw with Greece in a friendly on Wednesday.

Portugal remained in control in the first half, while Greece reversed roles to dominate in the second half of the match, a test before next month's World Cup qualifiers when Greece are away to Bosnia and Portugal travel to Northern Ireland.
Portugal were looking for a confidence-building performance after their 2-0 home defeat by 1998 World Cup hosts France in another friendly last month.
They had two chances in the first half but Luis Figo of Barcelona and Fernando Couto failed to convert them in the eighth and 27th minutes.
The Greeks put the pressure on in the second half. Costas Franzeskos hit the woodwork in the 50th minute and striker Demis Nikolaidis headed wide on the hour.
They had their best chance of the match seven minutes later when Baia fouled Nikolaidis in the box and won a penalty.
But the Barcelona goalkeeper redeemed himself by blocking the spot-kick from second half substitute Costas Franzeskos.
Portugal were without injured midfielder Rui Costa and central defender Jorge Costa.
"I am generally satisfied. It was a good test," Portugal team chief Artur Jorge said.
